title: Invitations
subtitle: Manage one-time invitation links within your workspace.

list.title: Invitation links
list.description: Invitations are listed newest-first. Raw tokens never appear here.

create.title: Create invitation
create.description: Invite a person so they can access this workspace.
create.step2Subtitle: Define what this person can view and change.
create.actorIdTaken: This actor ID already exists. Choose a different one.

doctor.title: Doctor
doctor.description: Can view and update clinical information about patients.

create.fullAccessDescription: This person will have access to every feature available in this workspace.
create.capabilitiesDescription: Capabilities the new member receives at acceptance.

success.title: Invitation created
success.description: Share this link with the invited person.
success.note: The link can be used only once to set the password.

errors.accessRequired: Choose an access level to continue.

cancel.confirmBody: The invitation link stops working immediately and the invitation is marked cancelled. You can send a new one later.

resend.confirmBody: A new link is generated and the previous one stops working. The 72-hour window restarts.

copyLink.title: Copy the invitation link
copyLink.description: Share this link with the invited person. It expires 72 hours after it is issued.
copyLink.securityNote: The link works once. Anyone with it can set the password for this invitation.

empty.title: No invitations yet
empty.description: Create an invitation to send the first link.
empty.help: The link works once and expires 72 hours after it is issued.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.description: You do not have permission to manage invitations.

accept.title: Set your password
accept.description: Complete your invitation to start using Cynara.
accept.passwordHint: Your password must meet these requirements:
accept.namesRequired: Enter your first and last name to continue.
accept.namesDescription: Your invitation does not include your name. Complete it to create your account.
accept.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters.
accept.passwordMissingUppercase: Add at least one uppercase letter (A–Z).
accept.passwordMissingLowercase: Add at least one lowercase letter (a–z).
accept.passwordMissingSymbol: Add at least one symbol (for example !, @, #).
accept.successDescription: Your membership is active and you can sign in now.
accept.invalidDescription: The invitation link is no longer available. Request a new invitation from the administrator.
accept.genericError: The request could not be completed. Try again.
